scope: Local evidence-to-claim review of R2-3; performed inline, not an independent peer review or submission certification.
assertions: All numerical manuscript entries trace to retained raw trajectories and recomputed summaries.
Integration interval, observation interval, and transport delay are distinguished.
Lorenz time units are not labeled as CSTR hours.
Short smooth-history convergence is not used as long-time chaotic pointwise convergence.
Deterministic CSTR refinement is not called stochastic convergence.
Fine-grid, not only already-sampled, spectra support the sampling discussion.
Current Jacobian, delayed tangent map, learned A, and full nonlinear predictor are distinguished.
No stiff-system accuracy theorem, no global stability guarantee, and no alias-free guarantee is asserted.
Previous eight rounds and original benchmark predictions are preserved.
